"import csv
from statistics import mean

from docx import Document

COLS = ["config", "cl_max", "cd_cruise", "ld_ratio"]
CSV_PATH = "perf_02.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.docx"


def load_rows(path):
    """Read the CSV, returning a list of dicts keyed by the canonical column
    names, preserving the source text of each value (same rounding as source)."""
    rows = []
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
        if reader.fieldnames:
            reader.fieldnames = [fn.strip().lower() for fn in reader.fieldnames]
        for rec in reader:
            if rec is None:
                continue
            vals = {c: (rec.get(c) or "").strip() for c in COLS}
            if all(vals[c] == "" for c in COLS):
                continue  # skip stray blank lines
            rows.append(vals)
    return rows


def main():
    rows = load_rows(CSV_PATH)
    n = len(rows)
    if n == 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"No data records found in {CSV_PATH}")

    # All numeric claims computed from the CSV values.
    cl_vals = [float(r["cl_max"]) for r in rows]
    cd_vals = [float(r["cd_cruise"]) for r in rows]
    ld_vals = [float(r["ld_ratio"]) for r in rows]

    cl_max_s = f"{max(cl_vals):.3f}"      # e.g. 0.525
    cd_mean_s = f"{mean(cd_vals):.4f}"    # e.g. 0.0339
    ld_mean_s = f"{mean(ld_vals):.1f}"    # e.g. 15.8
    best_cfg = max(rows, key=lambda r: float(r["ld_ratio"]))["config"]

    doc = Document()

    # Title (any wording) as a heading.
    doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report - Performance Data", level=0)

    # Overview section.
    doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"This report summarizes the engineering performance test dataset, "
        f"which contains N = {n} data rows."
    )

    # Results table section: header row + one row per data record.
    doc.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1 + n, cols=4)
    try:
        table.style = "Table Grid"
    except KeyError:
        pass
    for j, name in enumerate(COLS):
        table.cell(0, j).text = name
    for i, r in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        for j, c in enumerate(COLS):
            table.cell(i, j).text = r[c]

    # Summary section with the exact computed display values.
    doc.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"Across the {n} tested configurations, the maximum CLmax observed is "
        f"{cl_max_s}. The mean CDcruise is {cd_mean_s}, and the mean L/D ratio "
        f"is {ld_mean_s}. The best configuration, selected by the maximum L/D "
        f"ratio, is {best_cfg}."
    )

    # Conclusion section.
    doc.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
    doc.add_paragraph(
        f"The measured performance data show clear differences between the "
        f"tested configurations, with configuration {best_cfg} delivering the "
        f"highest L/D ratio. These data-anchored results provide a reliable "
        f"basis for down-selecting the preferred configuration in the next "
        f"phase of the engineering test program."
    )

    doc.save(OUT_PATH)
    print(f"Wrote {OUT_PATH}: {n} data rows; best config by L/D = {best_cfg}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
